title: Lochry's Defeat
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Lochry's Defeat", at revision 1370627040, opens: "Lochry's Defeat, also known as the Lochry massacre, was a battle fought on August 24, 1781, near present-day Aurora, Indiana, in the United States. The battle was part of the American Revolutionary War (1775–1783), which began as a conflict between Great Britain and the Thirteen Colonies before spreading to the western frontier, where American Indians entered the war as British allies. The battle was short and decisive: about one hundred Indians of local tribes led by Joseph Brant, a Mohawk military leader who was temporarily in the west, ambushed a similar number of Pennsylvania militiamen led by Archibald Lochry. Brant and his men killed or captured all of the Pennsylvanians without suffering any casualties." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q6665169, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1781 battle in Indiana, USA". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
